flow: policy or operator identifies suppress / expire / archive / consolidate / destroy candidate
backend classifier returns archive-first decision envelope
safe suppress / expire / archive actions show audit/export proof only when a future UI contract permits it
risky consolidate / destroy cases show a read-only review packet with preview, structural-loss rationale, snapshot policy, and audit policy
mutation controls remain disabled until designer-owned states and PM-reviewed action copy exist

structural_loss_consolidation: packet preview includes before refs, after plan, approval_required, mutation_separated
mutation boundary requires privacy scope, snapshot, and audit-before-mutate
destructive_destroy: classifier returns blocked state with archive listed before destroy
packet may be previewed but mutation boundary rejects blocked packet
audit_export_readback: automatic or reviewed action produces proof
proof can be reconstructed without transcript archaeology
ui_blocked: surface remains blocked because this artifact is a stub, not a designer-approved contract
future UI work must provide visual states, copy, accessibility, and PM review before implementation

explicit_blockers: No operator-facing CR-010 UI is implemented in this CR.
Designer-owned visual contract and PM review are required before enabling forgetting/consolidation controls.
MPL-6 temporal truth and broad archive/history browser work remain out of scope.

pm_review.notes: This CR ships backend/domain/evidence semantics only; it names the future control map and blocker boundary without authorizing UI implementation.
